data_fields.name: xp_to_reach_level
data_fields.donor_constant: cumulative table, e.g. level 10 = 48229, level 80 = 4200000000, level 81 = 6299994999

best_idea: Keep one number (total XP on the ledger) and derive the level from a cumulative threshold table, so the level can never disagree with the XP.
decision_why: Take the cumulative table and level lookup as data, but compute the XP bar within the current level and keep the XP award on the server; the donor's bar is total over the next cumulative threshold and falls back about 30% at each level-up.
acceptance: At 48229 total XP the XP bar reads 0% of level 10, not about 68%; a server test asserts levelFromTotalXp(71200) = 10 and levelFromTotalXp(71201) = 11.
